name: 7851-specdecode-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process engine; the draft head also runs at TP=1.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 800 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, request_format plain, fixed at 256 prompt tokens and 1024 output tokens (min=max on both), temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, no logprobs, no shared prefix.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter chat assistant with a draft model, streaming long replies to 32 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.5.5-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM (no V1 engine, no compilation config, no kv-connector).
# FLAT `key: value` LINES ONLY -- an indented YAML block is skipped and never reaches the engine.

# Ungated re-upload of `meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct` (Meta Llama 3 Community License).
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
speculative-model: ibm-ai-platform/llama3-8b-accelerator
num-speculative-tokens: 4
speculative-draft-tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Required, not a choice: this version raises without the V2 block manager, and its config
# constructor raises if chunked prefill and speculative decoding are both on.
use-v2-block-manager: true
enable-chunked-prefill: false

tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
enable-prefix-caching: false

# 4096 against a 256 + 1024 = 1280-token maximum sequence, and the headroom is deliberate: the
# proposer stops speculating for a sequence whose next tokens would run past the window, so a
# window sized near 1280 would quietly turn speculation off part-way through a request.
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-batched-tokens: 4096
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
dtype: bfloat16
enforce-eager: false
disable-logprobs-during-spec-decoding: true
seed: 0
